struct CommandError <: Exception
    message::String
end
fail(s) = throw(CommandError(s))
check(b, s) = b ? nothing : fail(s)
yesno(b) = b ? "yes" : "no"
numbers(xs) = join(xs, ' ')
struct Graph
    adj::BitMatrix
end
Graph(n::Int) = Graph(falses(n, n))
vertices(g) = size(g.adj, 1)
graphedges(g) = [(u, v) for u in 1:vertices(g) for v in (u+1):vertices(g) if g.adj[u, v]]
edgecount(g) = div(count(g.adj), 2)
function addedge!(g, u, v)
    g.adj[u, v]=true
    g.adj[v, u]=true
end
function sizecheck(n, minimum = 1, maximum = 16)
    check(n>=minimum, "bad value")
    check(n<=maximum, "too large")
end
function distances(g, start)
    d=fill(-1, vertices(g))
    d[start]=0
    queue=[start]
    at=1
    while at<=length(queue)
        u=queue[at]
        at+=1
        for v in 1:vertices(g)
            if g.adj[u, v] && d[v]<0
                d[v]=d[u]+1
                push!(queue, v)
            end
        end
    end
    d
end
function graphinfo(g)
    n=vertices(g)
    seen=falses(n)
    sizes=Int[]
    bipartite=true
    girth=typemax(Int)
    eccentricities=Int[]
    for root in 1:n
        d=distances(g, root)
        push!(eccentricities, maximum(d))
        if !seen[root]
            component=findall(>=(0), d)
            seen[component].=true
            push!(sizes, length(component))
        end
        for (u, v) in graphedges(g)
            d[u]>=0 && d[v]>=0 && iseven(d[u]-d[v]) && (bipartite=false)
        end
        depth=fill(-1, n)
        parents=zeros(Int, n)
        depth[root]=0
        queue=[root]
        at=1
        while at<=length(queue)
            u=queue[at]
            at+=1
            for v in 1:n
                g.adj[u, v] || continue
                if depth[v]<0
                    depth[v]=depth[u]+1
                    parents[v]=u
                    push!(queue, v)
                elseif v!=parents[u]
                    girth=min(girth, depth[u]+depth[v]+1)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    triangles=sum(g.adj[u, w] && g.adj[v, w] for (u, v) in graphedges(g) for w in (v+1):n; init = 0)
    degrees=sort!(vec(sum(g.adj; dims = 2)); rev = true)
    sort!(sizes; rev = true)
    (
        n = n,
        m = edgecount(g),
        degrees = degrees,
        triangles = triangles,
        sizes = sizes,
        girth = girth==typemax(Int) ? "none" : string(girth),
        diameter = length(sizes)==1 ? string(maximum(eccentricities)) : "INF",
        radius = length(sizes)==1 ? string(minimum(eccentricities)) : "INF",
        bipartite = yesno(bipartite),
    )
end
function maximumclique(g)
    best=Int[]
    function extend(clique, candidates)
        length(clique)>length(best) && (best=clique)
        for v in candidates
            extend([clique; v], [w for w in candidates if w>v && g.adj[v, w]])
        end
    end
    extend(Int[], collect(1:vertices(g)))
    best
end
function colouring(g, limit)
    colors=Int[]
    function extend(used)
        v=length(colors)+1
        v>vertices(g) && return true
        for color in 0:min(used, limit-1)
            any(w->g.adj[v, w] && colors[w]==color, 1:(v-1)) && continue
            push!(colors, color)
            extend(max(used, color+1)) && return true
            pop!(colors)
        end
        false
    end
    extend(0) ? colors : nothing
end
function rankkeys(keys)
    ordered=sort!(unique(keys))
    positions=Dict(key=>i-1 for (i, key) in enumerate(ordered))
    [positions[key] for key in keys]
end
degreecolors(g) = rankkeys(vec(sum(g.adj; dims = 2)))
function refine(g, colors)
    rounds=0
    while true
        signatures=[
            (colors[v], Tuple(sort!([colors[w] for w in 1:vertices(g) if g.adj[v, w]]))) for
            v in 1:vertices(g)
        ]
        next=rankkeys(signatures)
        maximum(next)==maximum(colors) && return colors, rounds
        colors=next
        rounds+=1
    end
end
stable(g) = refine(g, degreecolors(g))
cells(colors) = [findall(==(c), colors) for c in 0:maximum(colors)]
individualize(colors, v) = [c<colors[v] || w==v ? c : c+1 for (w, c) in enumerate(colors)]
function leafstring(g, labels)
    inverse=sortperm(labels)
    join(
        g.adj[inverse[i], inverse[j]] ? '1' : '0' for i in 1:vertices(g) for j in (i+1):vertices(g)
    )
end
struct Canonical
    nodes::Int
    leaves::Int
    text::String
    labels::Vector{Int}
    best::Vector{Vector{Int}}
end
function canonical(g)
    nodes=0
    leaves=0
    text=nothing
    labels=Int[]
    best=Vector{Int}[]
    function visit(colors)
        nodes+=1
        if maximum(colors)==vertices(g)-1
            leaves+=1
            s=leafstring(g, colors)
            if text===nothing || s>text
                text=s
                labels=colors
                best=[colors]
            elseif s==text
                push!(best, colors)
            end
            return
        end
        choices=[cell for cell in cells(colors) if length(cell)>1]
        chosen=choices[argmin(length.(choices))]
        for v in chosen
            next, _=refine(g, individualize(colors, v))
            visit(next)
        end
    end
    colors, _=stable(g)
    visit(colors)
    Canonical(nodes, leaves, text, labels, best)
end
function invariantreport(g, name)
    info=graphinfo(g)
    println("invariants $name\ndegrees ", numbers(info.degrees))
    println("edges $(info.m) triangles $(info.triangles)")
    println("components $(length(info.sizes)) sizes ", numbers(info.sizes))
    println(
        "girth $(info.girth) diameter $(info.diameter) radius $(info.radius)\nbipartite $(info.bipartite)",
    )
    if vertices(g)>=13
        println("clique -\nchromatic -")
        return
    end
    clique=maximumclique(g)
    println("clique $(length(clique)) ", numbers(clique .- 1))
    for limit in length(clique):vertices(g)
        colors=colouring(g, limit)
        if colors!==nothing
            println("chromatic $limit ", numbers(colors))
            return
        end
    end
end
function isoreport(a, b)
    x=graphinfo(a)
    y=graphinfo(b)
    tests=(
        ("vertices", x.n, y.n, true),
        ("edges", x.m, y.m, true),
        ("degrees", x.degrees, y.degrees, false),
        ("triangles", x.triangles, y.triangles, true),
        ("components", length(x.sizes), length(y.sizes), true),
        ("girth", x.girth, y.girth, true),
        ("diameter", x.diameter, y.diameter, true),
        ("bipartite", x.bipartite, y.bipartite, true),
    )
    for (name, left, right, shown) in tests
        if left!=right
            println("not isomorphic $name", shown ? " $left $right" : "")
            return
        end
    end
    ac, ar=stable(a)
    bc, br=stable(b)
    if ar!=br || length.(cells(ac))!=length.(cells(bc))
        println("not isomorphic refinement")
        return
    end
    af=canonical(a)
    bf=canonical(b)
    if af.text!=bf.text
        println("not isomorphic canonical")
        return
    end
    inverse=sortperm(bf.labels)
    println("isomorphic\nmapping ", numbers([inverse[label+1]-1 for label in af.labels]))
end
function automorphisms(g)
    form=canonical(g)
    inverse=sortperm(form.labels)
    [[inverse[label+1] for label in leaf] for leaf in form.best]
end
function automorphismreport(g, name)
    permutations=automorphisms(g)
    seen=Set{Int}()
    vorbits=Vector{Int}[]
    for v in 1:vertices(g)
        v in seen && continue
        orbit=sort!(unique([p[v] for p in permutations]))
        union!(seen, orbit)
        push!(vorbits, orbit)
    end
    eseen=Set{Tuple{Int,Int}}()
    eorbits=Vector{Tuple{Int,Int}}[]
    for (u, v) in graphedges(g)
        (u, v) in eseen && continue
        orbit=sort!(unique([minmax(p[u], p[v]) for p in permutations]))
        union!(eseen, orbit)
        push!(eorbits, orbit)
    end
    println("aut $name order $(length(permutations))\nvertex orbits $(length(vorbits))")
    for orbit in vorbits
        println("orbit ", numbers(orbit .- 1))
    end
    println("edge orbits $(length(eorbits))")
    for orbit in eorbits
        println("orbit ", join(["$(u-1)-$(v-1)" for (u, v) in orbit], ' '))
    end
    println("transitive vertex $(yesno(length(vorbits)==1)) edge $(yesno(length(eorbits)==1))")
end
function subisoreport(pattern, target, pname, tname)
    mapping=Int[]
    total=0
    induced=0
    shown=Tuple{Vector{Int},Bool}[]
    function extend()
        v=length(mapping)+1
        if v>vertices(pattern)
            exact=all(
                pattern.adj[u, w]==target.adj[mapping[u], mapping[w]] for u in 1:vertices(pattern)
                for w in (u+1):vertices(pattern)
            )
            total+=1
            induced+=exact
            length(shown)<5 && push!(shown, (copy(mapping), exact))
            return
        end
        for w in 1:vertices(target)
            w in mapping && continue
            all(u->!pattern.adj[v, u] || target.adj[w, mapping[u]], 1:(v-1)) || continue
            push!(mapping, w)
            extend()
            pop!(mapping)
        end
    end
    extend()
    order=length(canonical(pattern).best)
    println(
        "subiso $pname $tname embeddings $total induced $induced\ncopies $(div(total,order)) induced $(div(induced,order))",
    )
    for (image, exact) in shown
        println("embedding ", numbers(image .- 1), exact ? " induced" : "")
    end
end
function classify(n)
    sizecheck(n, 1, 5)
    pairs=[(u, v) for u in 1:n for v in (u+1):n]
    layers=[Set([canonical(Graph(n)).text])]
    for _ in eachindex(pairs)
        next=Set{String}()
        for text in layers[end]
            g=Graph(n)
            for (i, (u, v)) in enumerate(pairs)
                text[i]=='1' && addedge!(g, u, v)
            end
            for (i, (u, v)) in enumerate(pairs)
                if text[i]=='0'
                    changed=Graph(copy(g.adj))
                    addedge!(changed, u, v)
                    push!(next, canonical(changed).text)
                end
            end
        end
        push!(layers, next)
    end
    println("classify $n total $(sum(length,layers))")
    for (m, layer) in enumerate(layers)
        strings=sort!(collect(layer))
        println(
            "edges $(m-1) count $(length(layer)) ",
            join([isempty(s) ? "-" : s for s in strings], ' '),
        )
    end
end
const SCHEMAS=Dict(
    "GRAPH"=>["name", "number", "edge*"],
    "CYCLE"=>["name", "number"],
    "PATH"=>["name", "number"],
    "COMPLETE"=>["name", "number"],
    "BIPARTITE"=>["name", "number", "number"],
    "STAR"=>["name", "number"],
    "WHEEL"=>["name", "number"],
    "PETERSEN"=>["name"],
    "HYPERCUBE"=>["name", "number"],
    "CIRCULANT"=>["name", "number", "number+"],
    "GRID"=>["name", "number", "number"],
    "COMPLEMENT"=>["name", "graph"],
    "LINE"=>["name", "graph"],
    "PRODUCT"=>["name", "graph", "graph"],
    "UNION"=>["name", "graph", "graph"],
    "RELABEL"=>["name", "graph", "number*"],
    "INDUCED"=>["name", "graph", "number+"],
    "CANONIZE"=>["name", "graph"],
    "DELETE"=>["graph"],
    "LIST"=>String[],
    "SHOW"=>["graph"],
    "INVARIANTS"=>["graph"],
    "REFINE"=>["graph", "number*"],
    "CANON"=>["graph"],
    "ISO"=>["graph", "graph"],
    "AUT"=>["graph"],
    "SUBISO"=>["graph", "graph"],
    "CLASSIFY"=>["number"],
)
function arguments(command, words, registry)
    check(haskey(SCHEMAS, command), "unknown command $command")
    schema=SCHEMAS[command]
    repeat=!isempty(schema) && last(schema)[end] in ('*', '+')
    fixed=length(schema)-repeat
    check(
        repeat ? length(words)>=fixed+(last(schema)[end]=='+') : length(words)==fixed,
        "bad arguments",
    )
    for (i, word) in enumerate(words)
        kind=i<=fixed ? schema[i] : chop(last(schema))
        valid=kind in ("name", "graph") ? occursin(r"\A[a-z][a-z0-9]{0,7}\z", word) :
              kind=="number" ? occursin(r"\A(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,2})\z", word) :
              occursin(r"\A(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,2})-(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,2})\z", word)
        check(valid, "bad arguments")
    end
    for i in 1:fixed
        schema[i]=="graph" && check(haskey(registry, words[i]), "no graph $(words[i])")
    end
    nothing
end
function buildgraph(command, args, registry)
    if command in ("GRAPH", "CYCLE", "PATH", "COMPLETE", "CIRCULANT")
        n=parse(Int, args[2])
        sizecheck(n, command in ("CYCLE", "CIRCULANT") ? 3 : 1)
        g=Graph(n)
        if command=="GRAPH"
            for word in args[3:end]
                u, v=parse.(Int, split(word, '-'))
                check(u<n && v<n && u!=v, "bad edge $word")
                check(!g.adj[u+1, v+1], "duplicate edge $word")
                addedge!(g, u+1, v+1)
            end
        elseif command=="CYCLE"
            for u in 1:n
                addedge!(g, u, mod1(u+1, n))
            end
        elseif command=="PATH"
            for u in 1:(n-1)
                addedge!(g, u, u+1)
            end
        elseif command=="COMPLETE"
            for u in 1:n, v in (u+1):n
                addedge!(g, u, v)
            end
        else
            jumps=parse.(Int, args[3:end])
            check(
                all(j->j>0 && 2j<=n, jumps) && all(i->jumps[i]<jumps[i+1], 1:(length(jumps)-1)),
                "bad value",
            )
            for u in 1:n, j in jumps
                addedge!(g, u, mod1(u+j, n))
            end
        end
        return g
    elseif command in ("BIPARTITE", "GRID")
        a, b=parse.(Int, args[2:3])
        check(a>0 && b>0, "bad value")
        n=command=="GRID" ? a*b : a+b
        sizecheck(n)
        g=Graph(n)
        if command=="BIPARTITE"
            for u in 1:a, v in (a+1):(a+b)
                addedge!(g, u, v)
            end
        else
            for x in 0:(a-1), y in 0:(b-1)
                u=x*b+y+1
                y+1<b && addedge!(g, u, u+1)
                x+1<a && addedge!(g, u, u+b)
            end
        end
        return g
    elseif command in ("STAR", "WHEEL")
        k=parse(Int, args[2])
        sizecheck(k, command=="WHEEL" ? 3 : 1, 15)
        g=Graph(k+1)
        for v in 2:(k+1)
            addedge!(g, 1, v)
        end
        if command=="WHEEL"
            for u in 1:k
                addedge!(g, u+1, mod(u, k)+2)
            end
        end
        return g
    elseif command=="PETERSEN"
        g=Graph(10)
        for i in 0:4
            addedge!(g, i+1, mod(i+1, 5)+1)
            addedge!(g, i+1, i+6)
            addedge!(g, i+6, mod(i+2, 5)+6)
        end
        return g
    elseif command=="HYPERCUBE"
        d=parse(Int, args[2])
        sizecheck(d, 1, 4)
        n=2^d
        g=Graph(n)
        for v in 0:(n-1), bit in 0:(d-1)
            addedge!(g, v+1, xor(v, 1<<bit)+1)
        end
        return g
    end
    source=registry[args[2]]
    n=vertices(source)
    if command=="COMPLEMENT"
        g=Graph(n)
        for u in 1:n, v in (u+1):n
            !source.adj[u, v] && addedge!(g, u, v)
        end
        return g
    elseif command=="LINE"
        edges=graphedges(source)
        check(!isempty(edges), "no edges")
        sizecheck(length(edges))
        g=Graph(length(edges))
        for i in eachindex(edges), j in (i+1):length(edges)
            any(x->x in edges[j], edges[i]) && addedge!(g, i, j)
        end
        return g
    elseif command in ("PRODUCT", "UNION")
        other=registry[args[3]]
        m=vertices(other)
        size=command=="PRODUCT" ? n*m : n+m
        sizecheck(size)
        g=Graph(size)
        if command=="PRODUCT"
            for (u, v) in graphedges(source), y in 1:m
                addedge!(g, (u-1)*m+y, (v-1)*m+y)
            end
            for (u, v) in graphedges(other), x in 0:(n-1)
                addedge!(g, x*m+u, x*m+v)
            end
        else
            for (u, v) in graphedges(source)
                addedge!(g, u, v)
            end
            for (u, v) in graphedges(other)
                addedge!(g, u+n, v+n)
            end
        end
        return g
    elseif command in ("RELABEL", "CANONIZE")
        permutation=command=="CANONIZE" ? canonical(source).labels : parse.(Int, args[3:end])
        check(sort(permutation)==collect(0:(n-1)), "bad permutation")
        g=Graph(n)
        for (u, v) in graphedges(source)
            addedge!(g, permutation[u]+1, permutation[v]+1)
        end
        return g
    else
        selected=parse.(Int, args[3:end])
        check(all(v->v<n, selected) && length(unique(selected))==length(selected), "bad vertices")
        g=Graph(length(selected))
        for i in eachindex(selected), j in (i+1):length(selected)
            source.adj[selected[i]+1, selected[j]+1] && addedge!(g, i, j)
        end
        return g
    end
end
function execute!(registry, line)
    words=String.(split(line, ' '))
    command=words[1]
    args=words[2:end]
    arguments(command, args, registry)
    schema=SCHEMAS[command]
    if !isempty(schema) && schema[1]=="name"
        g=buildgraph(command, args, registry)
        name=args[1]
        status=haskey(registry, name) ? "redefined" : "defined"
        registry[name]=g
        println("$status $name n $(vertices(g)) m $(edgecount(g))")
        return
    end
    if command=="LIST"
        println("graphs $(length(registry))")
        for name in sort!(collect(keys(registry)))
            g=registry[name]
            println("$name n $(vertices(g)) m $(edgecount(g))")
        end
    elseif command=="CLASSIFY"
        classify(parse(Int, args[1]))
    elseif command=="DELETE"
        delete!(registry, args[1])
        println("deleted $(args[1])")
    else
        name=args[1]
        g=registry[name]
        if command=="SHOW"
            println("graph $name n $(vertices(g)) m $(edgecount(g))")
            for v in 1:vertices(g)
                neighbors=[w-1 for w in 1:vertices(g) if g.adj[v, w]]
                println("$(v-1):", isempty(neighbors) ? "" : " "*numbers(neighbors))
            end
        elseif command=="INVARIANTS"
            invariantreport(g, name)
        elseif command=="CANON"
            form=canonical(g)
            println(
                "canon $name nodes $(form.nodes) leaves $(form.leaves)\nlabels ",
                numbers(form.labels),
            )
            println("string ", isempty(form.text) ? "-" : form.text)
        elseif command=="REFINE"
            selected=parse.(Int, args[2:end])
            check(all(v->v<vertices(g), selected), "bad vertices")
            colors, rounds=stable(g)
            for v in selected
                check(count(==(colors[v+1]), colors)>1, "singleton $v")
                colors, extra=refine(g, individualize(colors, v+1))
                rounds+=extra
            end
            groups=cells(colors)
            println("refine $name rounds $rounds cells $(length(groups))")
            for (c, cell) in enumerate(groups)
                println("$(c-1): ", numbers(cell .- 1))
            end
        elseif command=="ISO"
            isoreport(g, registry[args[2]])
        elseif command=="AUT"
            automorphismreport(g, name)
        elseif command=="SUBISO"
            subisoreport(g, registry[args[2]], name, args[2])
        end
    end
end
function main()
    registry=Dict{String,Graph}()
    n=parse(Int, readline())
    for _ in 1:n
        line=readline()
        try
            execute!(registry, line)
        catch e
            e isa CommandError || rethrow()
            println("error: $(e.message)")
        end
    end
end
main()
